extracted.stage: Pre-application; IHT computation not yet finalised
extracted.summary: A senior associate at a law firm enquires about criteria and pricing for borrowing against a property in an estate of about £363,500 to cover inheritance tax and fees, with no loan amount yet determined.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding the estate and the executors' potential borrowing requirement. To take this further we would need the proposed loan amount once the IHT computation is available, confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, details of the estate assets including the property and any existing charges, and confirmation of the grant of probate position and the executors' details. We can then share our criteria and the information we would need for a formal assessment. Please note that nothing in this message constitutes an offer or an indication of terms. We look forward to hearing from you.
